title: Line and cable internal/external impedance and admittance formula corpus
purpose: Codex-ingestible, source-traceable corpus of the explicit analytical expressions found in the three supplied Datalab extractions.

included: single-core coaxial and pipe-enclosed cable assembly
insulation potential coefficients, capacitance, and documented loss terms
overhead, underground, submarine, and mixed overhead-underground earth-return impedance
overhead, underground, and mixed overhead-underground earth-return potential coefficient/admittance
excluded: propagation, modal transformation, line fitting, and transient-simulation formulas unless directly required to define Z or Y
formulas merely named in prose but not written explicitly in the supplied extractions

ingestion_notes.unit_of_record: One formula family with its attribution, application case, self/mutual rule, assumptions, local dependencies, and exact source locations.
ingestion_notes.latex: All formula strings are LaTeX without surrounding dollar delimiters.
ingestion_notes.keystring_rule: Formula-attribution keystrings use AuthorDescriptorYear, always ending in a four-digit year; EtAl is used where needed and Descriptor disambiguates distinct formula families from one attribution.
ingestion_notes.matrix_rule: External-potential-coefficient entries give P_e. Recover external admittance as Y_e=j\omega P_e^{-1}; do not invert elements individually for a multiconductor system.
ingestion_notes.self_mutual_rule: Where an entry supplies one indexed formula Z_ij or P_ij, the self term sets i=j and replaces transverse separation by the applicable outer radius; the mutual term uses conductor-center separation. Entry-specific rules take precedence.

self_mutual_coverage.internal: Self and mutual-surface terms are explicit for hollow shells, SC layers, semiconducting two-layer conductors, and pipe enclosures. Separate conductors have zero classical internal mutual blocks.
self_mutual_coverage.external_Z: Every indexed family carries either explicit self and mutual equations or a specialization rule. Mixed-media records are mutual-only and point to same-medium self families.
self_mutual_coverage.external_Y: Potential-coefficient self and mutual terms are explicit. Multiconductor admittance is obtained by matrix inversion, never by elementwise reciprocal.

named_but_not_explicitly_reproduced.reason: The supplied extractions discuss it but do not print the series; the integral and a later closed form are included instead.

named_but_not_explicitly_reproduced.formula_family: Kikuchi and Wedepohl-Efthymiadis complete-field overhead formulas
named_but_not_explicitly_reproduced.reason: Named and reviewed in AmetaniEtAl2021, but the main closed expressions are not printed in the supplied relevant sections.
CIGRE2025 Section 2.2.2.3 contains a drafting placeholder rather than the equations.

The sources name tan(delta), state that it is neglected or uncertain at transient frequencies, and do not supply a frequency law. The corpus separately tags the standard G=omega C tan(delta) conversion as algebraic rather than verbatim extraction.
